notes: Known: Kallat, arXiv:2610.40342 (2026), Thm 8.15/Rem 8.16 (p-saturated cycle-length sets give v_p(a(n)) >= v_p(n!)), Lean proof in its ancillary Saturation.lean (saturated_valuation, sat_residue), not re-run here. Re-derived: since p = 1 mod r the class is closed under multiplication/division by p, e.g.f. = prod_u E_p(x^u)^(1/u) with Artin-Hasse E_p p-integral. Outside Lean: all of it in this repository (Kallat's Lean external); certificate/check.py checks v_p(a(n)) >= v_p(n!) for p < 60, n <= 400.
